{"rule_yaml": "title: PowerShell Execution via Outlook
id: 4f2a1b3c-5d6e-7f8a-9b0c-1d2e3f4a5b6c
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell execution launched by Outlook with common evasion flags (Bypass, Hidden).
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: process_creation
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith: '\OUTLOOK.EXE'
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 
            - '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass'
            - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
    condition: selection
fields:
    - Computer
    - User
    - CommandLine
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate Outlook add-ins or administrative scripts launched via email (rare).
level: high
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
"}

{"rule_text": "rule Malware_PowerShell_AMSI_Bypass {
    meta:
        description = "Detects PowerShell script with AMSI bypass and specific persistence mechanisms"
        author = "SOC Analyst"
        date = "2024-11-16"
    strings:
        $amsi_bypass = "amsiInitFailed" nocase
        $reg_persistence = "Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run" nocase
        $task_persistence = "New-ScheduledTaskAction" nocase
        $keylog_api = "user32.dll" nocase
    condition:
        all of them
}"}
